grade_definitions.A: Trusted / Confirmed — From official filing, regulatory source, or directly verified customs data
grade_definitions.B: Reliable — Approved paid market report (Richard report), reputable data provider, trusted trade track record
grade_definitions.C: Unverified — Plausible single unverified article, field talk, or trade gossip requiring corroboration
grade_definitions.D: Rumour — Market rumour or hearsay, logged for pattern detection but clearly flagged
